  "title": "fix(runtime): report unhandled rejections, stop stb_ds seed race, log dropped events",
  "body": "## Problem

An unhandled promise rejection in a Deck App (e.g. a `fetch` chain without a `catch`) was swallowed silently, because the JS thread never installed QuickJS's rejection tracker (#69). Separately, TSan found the JS and main threads both writing stb_ds's global `stbds_hash_seed` (#78).

## Fix

- **Rejections (#69):** `src/core/js_runtime.c` installs `JS_SetHostPromiseRejectionTracker`. Rejections without a handler are held until the microtask queue drains. If a handler attaches in the meantime (QuickJS calls the tracker again with `is_handled` true), the rejection is dropped. Anything still pending is reported through the same path as other uncaught errors and shows the Deck App Failure Screen. `CONTEXT.md` documents this choice. `js_limits_harness` gains three scenarios: an unhandled rejection at boot, one inside a timer, and a rejection whose `catch` attaches in a later microtask, which must not fail the app.
- **Hash seed (#78):** seeding once at startup would not fix the race. stb_ds advances the global seed with an LCG every time any thread creates a new hash map, so every map creation is a write. The vendored `stb_ds.h` now only reads the seed (one hunk, marked `VitaDeck:`). Each table already keeps its own seed, so hashing is unchanged per table.
- `event_queue_push` now logs a `TraceLog` warning when it drops an event on a full queue. Drop-newest behaviour is unchanged.

## Verification

- `fast` on macOS. `tsc` only passes after `pnpm --dir js build`, which was already true before this change.
- `host` + smoke (all 12 CTest harnesses) in the Linux smoke Docker image, both plain and with `VITADECK_SANITIZE=address,undefined`.
- Vita build in the Vitasdk Docker image.
- One manual TSan run in Docker (not wired into CI). `snapshot_swap_harness` and `event_queue_harness` were clean. `js_limits_harness` reports no stb_ds race; the races it does report are on the existing `volatile` `failed`/`failure_message` fields of `VdJsRuntime`, which are out of scope here.

Review: https://matemolnar8.github.io/vitadeck/pr/81/

Fixes #69
Fixes #78
